payload.title: Site card View Details button in the farm Setup Sites tab navigates to /sites/:siteId, which the farm remote only redirects back to the sites list, so the link is dead and never reaches the site monitor
evidence: web/modules/farm-module/src/Module.tsx:152-154 (the :siteId route is a Navigate back to /sites/setup/sites; the detail page was removed)
web/modules/farm-module/src/Module.tsx:146-147 (the site monitor route environment/:siteId exists and is not linked)
tests/invariants/web-console-nav-coverage.spec.ts:21-23 (the dead-link rule covers nav entries, tabs and patterns only, not in-page links)
payload.rule_violated: The console navigation contract (FE-HIGH-334/335: every link names a real page, never a redirect hop) is broken by an in-page link.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-27, release R7.
